对越自卫反击战取得胜利，各部队陆续回国之后，燕京立即成立了中央慰问团，这个慰问团的规格极高，向参战官兵传达燕京首长的关怀，并听取作战汇报。
127师在这次作战中歼敌数量排名第八，除了第七名是西线滇省方向出国作战的37师外，其余均为东线作战部队。
歼敌数量前两名均为55军下辖部队，这些部队在谅山方向歼敌，该区域是作战的核心区域。
4月16号，刘济民乘坐吉普来到了洛阳新安县城。师部所在地是381团的团部，这里原先是个坡，127师师部驻扎下来后，当地人就把这里称作“师部坡”。
中央慰问团的首长今天要在师部礼堂召开基层干部会议，慰问基层连队主官。
距离会议召开还有一段时间，刘济民先去旁边的师部医院看了看受伤的马贵生和九连战士。
“团长，我先去医院一会儿！”
高团长看了看时间，大手一挥：“去吧，不要晚了，把他给我带过来！”
“是！”
刘济民先到旁边的供销社买了几大兜副食品，之后走进了师部医院。
医院内，许多受伤的战士正在散步，截肢的战士也有专门的护士推着，九连的战士看到刘济民后，都笑着围了上来，但眼神里的悲伤无论如何都抹不去。
大家纷纷问小六的情况，刘济民将知道的全部告诉了大家。刘济民将礼品分发给大家后，马贵生让众人离开。
“济民，开会我就不去了吧，我一个快要转业的。”马贵生无奈地抬了抬胳膊。
“只要你还没退伍，就还是九连的连长，怎么能不去？战斗是你带着大家打的。”

After the victory in the self-defense counterattack against Vietnam and the troops returning to China one after another, Yanjing immediately established a Central Consolation Group. This condolence group was of extremely high standards to convey the concern of Yanjing's chief to the officers and soldiers participating in the war, and to listen to combat reports.
The 127th Division ranked eighth in the number of enemies it wiped out in this battle. Except for the seventh place, which was the 37th Division that went abroad to fight in Yunnan Province on the western front, the rest were all combat troops on the eastern front.
The top two in terms of number of enemies annihilated were both units under the 55th Army. These troops wiped out enemies in the direction of Lang Son, which is the core area of ​​the operation.
On April 16, Liu Jimin took a jeep to Xin'an County, Luoyang. The division headquarters is located at the headquarters of the 381st Regiment. It was originally a slope. After the 127th Division headquarters was stationed, the locals called it the "Division Headquarters Slope".
The head of the Central Condolence Group will hold a meeting of grassroots cadres in the division headquarters auditorium today to express condolences to the grassroots company chiefs.
There was still some time before the meeting, so Liu Jimin went to the nearby division hospital to see the injured Ma Guisheng and the soldiers of the Ninth Company.
"Captain, I'm going to the hospital for a while!"
Captain Gao looked at the time and waved his hand: "Go, don't be late, bring him here to me!"
"Yes!"
Liu Jimin first went to the nearby supply and marketing cooperative to buy several large bags of non-staple food, and then walked into the division hospital.
In the hospital, many injured soldiers were walking, and amputated soldiers were also pushed by special nurses. When the soldiers of the Ninth Company saw Liu Jimin, they all gathered around him with smiles, but the sadness in their eyes could not be erased no matter what.
Everyone asked about Xiaoliu's situation, and Liu Jimin told everyone everything he knew. After Liu Jimin distributed the gifts to everyone, Ma Guisheng asked everyone to leave.
"Jimin, I won't go to the meeting. I'm about to change my job." Ma Guisheng raised his arm helplessly.
"As long as you haven't retired from the army, you are still the commander of the ninth company. How can you not go? You led everyone in the battle."
